verdict: Organic visibility is growing, but no paid engine is converting leads yet.
narrative: No paid advertising ran this period — zero spend across Meta and Google Ads means lead generation relied entirely on organic channels. Your Google Business Profile delivered 52 actions over 28 days, and Search Console clicks rose 20% week-over-week, showing your organic presence is gaining ground. Website sessions jumped 39% this past week, yet no tracked conversions resulted, meaning visitors are arriving but not taking the next step. GBP engagement softened in the final days of the period, which is being watched closely. Reactivating a paid channel is the move that will turn this growing visibility into actual leads.
